001package org.clafer.choco.constraint;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Constraint;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.binary.PropEqualX_Y;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropSetEqual;
010import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropSetNotEqual;
011import org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.PropUtil;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class SetEquality extends Constraint {
018
019    private final SetVar left, right;
020    private final IntVar leftCard, rightCard;
021    private final boolean equal;
022
023    public SetEquality(SetVar left, IntVar leftCard, boolean equal, SetVar right, IntVar rightCard) {
024        super(equal ? "setEqual" : "setNotEqual", equal
025                ? new Propagator[]{new PropSetEqual(left, right), new PropEqualX_Y(leftCard, rightCard)}
026                : new Propagator[]{new PropSetNotEqual(left, right)});
027        this.left = left;
028        this.leftCard = leftCard;
029        this.equal = equal;
030        this.right = right;
031        this.rightCard = rightCard;
032    }
033
034    @Override
035    public Constraint makeOpposite() {
036        return new SetEquality(left, leftCard, !equal, right, rightCard);
037    }
038
039    @Override
040    public ESat isSatisfied() {
041        ESat satisfied = super.isSatisfied();
042        if (ESat.UNDEFINED.equals(satisfied)) {
043            int intersectionSize = PropUtil.intersectionSize(left.getUB(), right.getUB());
044            int possibleCard = leftCard.previousValue(intersectionSize + 1);
045            while (possibleCard >= leftCard.getLB() && !rightCard.contains(possibleCard)) {
046                possibleCard = leftCard.previousValue(possibleCard);
047            }
048            if (possibleCard < leftCard.getLB() || possibleCard < rightCard.getLB()) {
049                return ESat.eval(!equal);
050            }
051        }
052        return satisfied;
053    }
054}
